whoItsFor: Developers and teams building pipelines or AI agents that ingest mixed office documents and need consistent, LLM-ready Markdown output, whether in Rust, Node.js, Python, or the browser.
useCases: Converting Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and PDF files into Markdown for LLM or RAG ingestion
Giving AI agents the ability to read office documents they encounter
Normalizing mixed-format document batches into one consistent Markdown output
